objective: Diagnostico aislado READ_ONLY de la consulta INDEXES del Gate3B Custodia. No DDL/DML, no cambios de repositorio, no Produccion.

queries.name: indexes
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(i.object_id) AS schema_name, OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) AS table_name, i.name AS index_name FROM sys.indexes i WHERE i.name IN ('UX_Custodia_Recurso_ActivoID','IX_Custodia_Recurso_ProductoID','IX_Custodia_Recurso_Contexto','UX_Custodia_Resguardo_RecursoVigente','IX_Custodia_Resguardo_ColaboradorEstado','IX_Custodia_Resguardo_Contexto','IX_Custodia_Resguardo_FechaOperacion','IX_Custodia_Movimiento_ResguardoFecha','IX_Custodia_Devolucion_ResguardoFecha','IX_Custodia_Incidencia_ResguardoEstado','IX_Custodia_Cargo_IncidenciaEstado') ORDER BY i.name;
